mainEntity.name: Which Notion alternative is best for a team?

acceptedAnswer.text: ClickUp is a strong choice when task management is the main need. Slab is better for a focused company wiki, while Confluence suits organizations that already rely on Jira and Atlassian administration.

mainEntity.name: Which Notion alternative has a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: ClickUp, Confluence, Slab, Nuclino, Obsidian, Anytype and Taskade all publish free entry options. Their limits differ, so compare seats, items, storage, local features and paid add-ons rather than treating every free plan as equal.

Obsidian stores notes as local Markdown files. Anytype is built around local-first data and sync. Notion also supports downloaded pages in its desktop and mobile apps, but it does not provide the same full local-file workflow.

mainEntity.name: Can I move my Notion workspace to another tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notion can export pages as HTML or Markdown and databases as CSV. You should still expect to rebuild relations, formulas, views, permissions and automations that do not transfer as native objects.

mainEntity.name: Which alternative is closest to Notion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nuclino is a close option for a lighter team wiki and collaborative docs. Taskade is closer when a team wants docs, projects and AI agents together. Neither reproduces every Notion database and permission feature.
